notes: The main PDP-style buy box: 10-image product-specific gallery with thumbnails, 3 age-group product tabs (Teens' active), title/rating, 3 benefit accordions with stat copy hidden inside closed <details>, delivery + quantity selectors with preselected defaults (Monthly, 2 Bottles — the original's cart summary prices '(2x)'), gift progress, 3 upsells, 3 info accordions and age crosslink cards. Easy to miss: all three age products must swap in place with distinct galleries, the checked defaults, the accordion copy that body innerText never shows, and that description/flavor/ages copy resolves from product metafields — if seeding failed the section renders but silently drops that copy.

assertions.why: Original has exactly three age-group tabs above the title: Toddlers', Kids', Teens'.
The Teens' tab must be marked active and carry the product handle that powers in-place buy-box swapping.

assertions.why: Clicking each age tab must replace the complete product context without a page load: all three have ten product-specific gallery images and the extracted title, subtitle, flavor, benefits, and monthly/one-time offer prices, with three distinct hero images.
Product title byte-for-byte, including the ™ glyph and the typographic apostrophe a retype would lose.
The rating row must show the original review count.

assertions.contains: A unique organic fruit and veggie blend, plus 12 key nutrients.
assertions.why: Description comes from product metafield custom.short_description (the section setting is intentionally empty) — catches a missing metafield seed.
Flavor line comes from metafield custom.flavor and includes the orange emoji the original renders.
Original has exactly three benefit accordions: Health & Nutrition, Mood & Motivation, Clear Skin.
The three Teen benefits must use distinct heart/health, positive-mood, and clear-skin symbols instead of repeating a generic shield.

assertions.contains: of parents say First Day vitamins support their teen's overall health & nutrition.†
assertions.why: The 98% stat copy lives inside a closed <details> — a screenshot and body innerText both miss it, so assert on the element itself.
Original offers exactly four quantity tiers (1–4 bottles).
The original preselects 2 Bottles — its cart summary prices the multi '(2x)'. A screenshot can't prove which radio is checked.
The One-Time option's promo-code note is distinctive copy that is easy to drop when rebuilding the delivery selector.
The current original gallery has exactly 10 product media, each reachable via a thumbnail button.
Original shows exactly three upsell cards: Focus Brain Support, Nighttime Reset Magnesium, 3-in-1 Probiotic.

assertions.contains: Organic Superfood Blend: Apple, Kale, Broccoli, Spinach, Carrot, Parsley, Beet, Green Cabbage, Raspberry, Blueberry, Strawberry, Tomato, Aronia Berry, Chlorella, Maca, Moringa, Reishi Mushroom, Cordyceps Mushroom, Lion's Mane Mushroom, Turmeric, Ginger
assertions.why: The full superfood list sits inside the closed Ingredients accordion; asserting the whole list catches truncated rich text.
The 4-tier quantity grid, thumbnail strip and delivery cards are the widest content on the page — none may overflow at 390px.
Product tabs and age crosslink cards link to sibling LP pages; every relative href must resolve 200.
